title: Tarot Table
tagline: A phone companion for a real tarot deck: the spread laid out as places on a table, the card you drew tapped into its place, what it means there and a question to ask.
readinessNote: The whole deck is data: 78 cards in one JSON list (Data/Cards), each with keywords, a meaning and a question both ways up, and a deeper look (the picture, why it means this, love, work and self, the card as a person, more questions). The spreads and their positions, with where each card lies on the table, are another list (Data/Spreads). The 78 card pictures are SVG files drawn by one script (tools/draw-cards.mjs), replaceable one by one. Rewrite the voice or add a spread without touching the graph. It installs on a phone and works offline (pwa/).
buildYourOwn: Your own voice for the cards, new spreads, another language, a different deck's names (Thoth, Marseille).
